title: Young Boy Gary Holding Toy Shovel, 1955 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A crisp black-and-white 1955 snapshot capturing a young boy named Gary posing outdoors in a grassy yard while holding a small toy shovel. He wears a striped short-sleeve shirt, trousers held up with suspenders, and canvas sneakers. A residential building with a fuel tank, utility pole, and clothesline forms the backdrop. The right margin is stamped 'MAY • 55', confirming the development date.
